selection_policy: Sixteen predeclared popular JavaScript and infrastructure repositories with public GH Archive activity. The whole-repository test split intentionally contains the previously published webpack hero and v1/v2 holdout repositories; it was fixed before inspecting the other repositories.

label_rule.unit: repository UTC hour with an activity spike
label_rule.activity_spike: At least five raw, non-pull-request issue-opened or issue-comment-created events in the hour. This permissive candidate rule is independent of detector v1/v2 firings and deliberately retains automation floods.
label_rule.candidate_timestamp: One microsecond after the final qualifying source event in the candidate hour. Features may use only events strictly before this timestamp.
label_rule.positive: The earliest candidate hour for an issue visible in that hour at or before the candidate timestamp, with pre-candidate breakage/regression text and a later non-bot OWNER/MEMBER/COLLABORATOR issue comment classified TRUE by the committed phrase rule within 72 hours.
label_rule.negative: Every candidate spike hour not assigned a canonical positive incident is negative; deterministic incident cooldown is evaluated separately from the model.
label_rule.negative_acknowledgment: Comments classified FALSE by the committed phrase rule never create a positive.

feature_policy.phase: same UTC hour and weekday/weekend class
feature_policy.text: cross-thread token and character-shingle similarity from strictly pre-candidate issue activity
